# Extensions and tabs {#extensions}

The 18 November rulings D3 to D7 give extensions explicit source forms such as `:wiki[...]` and `:cite[...]`, and a tabs contract with `selected` and static output, in place of host extensions that read core syntax ([#6070](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/pull/6070)). The extension mechanism is still provisional.

Tool: Review by hand.

```text
A wiki target needs the explicit `:wiki[Page]` extension form (C2-X-057). A reference may instead be a core reference, so report and choose from its resolved target.
```
:::

**U-416** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> :::: tabs ⏎ ::: tab "Install" ⏎ Run. ⏎ ::: ⏎ :::: (0.1 host setting `mode: 'aria'`)

::::: compare no-render
```text
:::: tabs
::: tab "Install"
Run.
:::
::::
```
```text
<div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Tabs"><button type="button" role="tab" id="tabs-1-0" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tabs-1-0-panel">Install</button>… The 0.1 host setting `mode: 'aria'` maps onto the option `mode: 'aria'` of the 0.2 tabs renderer (C2-X-043, C2-X-056), which writes the same WAI-ARIA tab pattern and leaves the switching script to the host. The ids are `tabs-N-K` and `tabs-N-K-panel` (C2-X-048), not `tabset-N-tab-K` and `tabset-N-panel-K`, and a tab id does not supply them; the buttons carry no class, the panels the class `tab-panel`, and no line break separates the elements. No source edit; set the option and check host scripts and styles that select the 0.1 ids or classes.
```
:::::

```text
<div class="tabs" role="group" aria-label="Tabs"><input type="radio" name="tabs-1" id="tabs-1-0"><label for="tabs-1-0">A</label><input type="radio" name="tabs-1" id="tabs-1-1" checked><label for="tabs-1-1">B</label>… C2-X-056 keeps `selected`: the first marked tab is the initially selected tab and with no mark the first tab is, as in 0.1. No source edit is needed; the renderer markup around it is a host matter (U-416, U-419).
```

**U-419** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> :::: tabs ⏎ ::: tab "Install" ⏎ Run. ⏎ ::: ⏎ :::: (static mode)
Tool: Review the host's static HTML processing.

::::: compare no-render
```text
:::: tabs
::: tab "Install"
Run.
:::
::::
```
```text
<div class="tabs" role="group" aria-label="Tabs"><section class="tabs-panel"><h3 class="tabs-label">Install</h3><p>Run.</p></section></div> Static mode keeps the 0.1 static elements and classes (C2-X-043) but writes no line breaks between them and no 0.1 roundtrip carrier attributes, and the heading holds the title with its inline markup. Report so a host that processes static HTML can check it.
```

**U-428** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> :::: tabs ⏎ ::: tab "A" ⏎ a ⏎ ::: ⏎ ⏎ stray ⏎ ::::
Tool: Review by hand.

::::: compare no-render
```text
:::: tabs
::: tab "A"
a
:::

stray
::::
```
```text
0.1 left a block that is not a tab out of the tabs output; 0.2 claims a group only when every block in it is a tab (C2-X-040), so the whole group stays a core div and its default render does not change. Report the block: moving it out of the group or into a tab changes the document.
```
:::::
